column3: Close to the Hebrew; “gird up your loins” is rendered “prepare yourself.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I broke on it my boundary” is rendered “I fixed My limit for it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the recesses of the deep” is rendered “in search of the depths.”
Close to the Hebrew; צַלְמָוֶת (“deep darkness”) is rendered “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; לַשֶּׁטֶף (“the flood”) is rendered “the overflowing water,” and “the storm of thunderclaps” “the thunderbolt.”
